This supersedes the earlier intended-Standard pair failure, preserving it. No firmware cause is assigned to the earlier selection discrepancy.

subtype15_layout.ignored_alignment: command+0x2a/+0x2b not read by this decoder

contracts.subtype6_difference: coefficients <<2; offsets*8+0x800; auxiliary word0; do not apply this scaling to subtype15

contracts.encoding: eleven signed halfwords sign-extended to32-bit; auxiliary word unchanged
contracts.bypass_rule: object+0x28 zero selects value+0x10=1; nonzero selects+0x14=0
contracts.ownership: object-owned decoded fields; direct entry writes MMIO, queued entry appends address/value records to caller-owned list
